correctness.rationale: For n>=7, four distinct cyclic neighbors are exactly offsets ±1,±2. A legal first force exists precisely at a black vertex with >=3 black neighbors, and then all five centered consecutive vertices become black. A length-five black interval monotonically propagates around the cycle, proving the equivalence for every subset and n. Failed words are precisely those avoiding a central selected position with >=3 selected neighbors in its five-window, so the explicit 16-state transfer trace bijection is exact. The finite 16x16 determinant is reconstructed by integer-polynomial Newton identities from 16 exact traces in verify.py and equals the displayed degree-eight polynomial; the formal trace/determinant relation proves the generating function for arbitrary n, not by extrapolating finite cases. The min-cardinality and 3n count follow from four-subset centers, and the maximum failed size by cut counting plus explicit cyclic strings. Exhaustive direct iterative forcing/transfer checks cover all 32,640 subsets on orders n=7..14. Boundary n>=7, complement empty and all-black configurations, and the distinction from skew forcing were checked.

The present evaluated bivariate rational enumerator counts every ordinary failed subset of each cycle square using an exact induced-degree equivalence. value.rationale: The object is the natural infinite graph family of quartic cycle-square circulants, and the invariant is the whole ordinary zero-forcing polynomial rather than an isolated exceptional size. The induced maximum-degree-two characterization replaces arbitrary iterative propagation with a local structural constraint, permitting an unusually compact evaluated degree-eight rational bivariate enumerator for all n>=7. It yields every intermediate cardinality count and both extremal regimes from one proof, information not determined by the classical minimum zero-forcing number or by a failed-number theorem. The explicit denominator and checkable recurrence constitute a useful closed exact classification, not merely a routine named parameter or a small computational increment. Main risks are prior equivalent forbidden-word enumerations, separately acknowledged.
